name: Energy Shield
description: Fits this unit or an ally within %cast_range% tiles with a barrier that absorbs %barrier% damage before it reaches their health, lasting %duration% turns.

upgrade.summary: This unit also carries its own barrier, mending %passive_regen% a turn up to %passive_barrier_max%.
details: This unit permanently wears a barrier of its own, gaining %passive_regen% at the start of each turn up to %passive_barrier_max%.
That barrier is entirely separate from the one this ability casts - a shielded Maxwell carries both at once.
